foreign_keys.name: fk_requests_client
foreign_keys.definition: FOREIGN KEY (client_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

foreign_keys.name: fk_requests_service
foreign_keys.definition: FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

foreign_keys.name: fk_reviews_request
foreign_keys.definition: FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES service_requests(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

foreign_keys.name: fk_reviews_reviewer
foreign_keys.definition: FOREIGN KEY (reviewer_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

foreign_keys.name: fk_services_provider
foreign_keys.definition: FOREIGN KEY (provider_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

checks.name: chk_service_requests_status
checks.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'ACCEPTED'::character varying, 'IN_PROGRESS'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying])::text[])))

checks.name: chk_services_category
checks.definition: CHECK (((category)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['LIMPEZA'::character varying, 'DIARISTA'::character varying, 'ENCANAMENTO'::character varying, 'ELETRICA'::character varying, 'JARDINAGEM'::character varying, 'PINTURA'::character varying, 'MARCENARIA'::character varying, 'PEDREIRO'::character varying, 'DEDETIZACAO'::character varying, 'AR_CONDICIONADO'::character varying, 'CHAVEIRO'::character varying, 'MONTAGEM_MOVEIS'::character varying, 'MUDANCA'::character varying, 'SUPORTE_TECNICO'::character varying, 'MANUTENCAO_COMPUTADORES'::character varying, 'DESENVOLVIMENTO_SOFTWARE'::character varying, 'REDES_E_INFRAESTRUTURA'::character varying, 'SEGURANCA_DIGITAL'::character varying, 'RECUPERACAO_DE_DADOS'::character varying, 'CONSULTORIA_TI'::character varying, 'OUTROS'::character varying])::text[])))
